evidence:
Method: static tree comparison of the frozen snapshot against the closed file list in staged-task-contract.md:5-32, applied by hand. The private checkers check-no-stray-files.py and check-required-files.py were NOT executed (not available in this workspace); this is a manual review, not a checker or portal result.

Required files, all present and non-empty (find over .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r2/task, 37 files, no zero-byte file, no empty directory, no symlink): instruction.md; task.toml; environment/Dockerfile; environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}; environment/assets/seed_data.json; solution/solve.sh; solution/app/server.js plus app tree; tests/{Dockerfile,test.sh,scoring.toml,app_context.md (1527 bytes),.dockerignore}; tests/gates/{render,constraints}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}; tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}; tests/tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py}.

Nothing outside the closed list: top level holds only instruction.md, task.toml, environment/, solution/, tests/. tests/ holds exactly the 7 listed entries plus gates/ and scored/ with exactly the five fixed dimension directories, each containing only judge.toml and prompt.md. environment/ holds only Dockerfile, instructions/ (2 notes) and assets/seed_data.json. The only dot-file is tests/.dockerignore, which is on the list. A name search for *.bak, *~, *.orig, *.rej, *.swp, *.tmp, *.log, *.db*, *.sqlite*, *.zip, *.xlsx, *.png, *.pyc, __pycache__, node_modules, package-lock.json, coverage.json, .env*, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, NOTES.md, SOLUTION.md, reward.toml returned no match. No CRLF and no BOM in any file. A content grep for TODO/FIXME/XXX/CHANGE-ME/lorem ipsum/scratch/backup/.bak/debugger found only solution/app/src/bootstrap.js:44, a startup console.log, which is not residue.

Tree diff against the frozen template: the task differs only by environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md replacing the template's notes.md (the contract allows 'one or more operating notes'; instruction.md:13 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md and environment/Dockerfile:14 copies instructions/) and by 12 additional files under solution/app/**, which the contract permits as the golden app. Every one of those 12 is in use: server.js:2 requires src/index.js; index.js:4,23,24,432 require bootstrap, db, rules, change-sets; index.js:38 serves public/; public/index.html:7,52-54 load styles.css, js/hireops.js, js/change-sets.js, js/app.js; package.json is the app manifest. No orphan or dead file. tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the template.

Note, not a defect: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is a byte-identical copy (sha256 1b390154...8bcf7) of environment/assets/seed_data.json. It sits inside solution/app/** and is the first path solution/app/src/db.js:14 reads, so it is a used app file, not a backup. SKILL.md:67 and quality-checks.md:202 say a task-specific seed_data.json flagged by the stray-file checker is a known false positive to report as Note, never a blocker; the hosted checker may still flag it. Whether the golden should read its own copy instead of /assets is a matter for rows 13, 19 and 20, not this row.

Hashes verified: the canonical digest of manifest.json inputs recomputes to the assigned input_sha256; all 71 file hashes in the manifest match the cache bytes; the manifest lists exactly the 37 task files on disk (none extra, none missing). The live folder projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations has the same 37 files with identical bytes, no git-ignored or untracked entries, and its parent directory holds nothing else, so the freeze's ignore set (__pycache__, .git, node_modules) hid nothing. All 10 raw-evidence-index.json artifact hashes and their matching_source_files hashes recompute correctly; those artifacts live under qc/repairs, outside the task folder, and are not needed for this static row.

Counterexample attempts: (a) a folder with stray residue that would still pass this review - hidden files, empty directories, ignored-by-freeze directories and unused solution files were each searched for and none exists; (b) a conforming folder that would wrongly fail - the renamed operating note and the in-app seed copy are both permitted by the contract and the skill, so neither is failed. Row 50 has no runtime dimension, so run_verdict stays NOT EXERCISED without creating a risk.
